reason: The Tree-wide guards step also runs tests/test_installer_bash32.py, an in-process scan of the installer and preflight shell files under ops/ (six of them, eight with the native hook and preflight scripts) for what bash 3.2 misreads, so an ordinary pull request sees it before a batch's macOS lane; no setup, service or install was added and the scan takes under a second, so the job's measured cost holds.
